'''James Weldon''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 Roseville Enduro]] on 10 March 2001 with [[There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him|There Is Good In Him]], according to Nick Stefanko's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1871">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-11-3-10-01-enduro-2nd-quarterd1871/ 3-10-01-enduro-2nd-quarter], DeckTech (Nick "JediBrain" Stefanko, 11 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-11-3-10-01-enduro-2nd-quarterd1871/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
